activity.notes: Stroessner led the 4 May 1954 coup and was Paraguay's de facto ruler during the provisional presidency of Tomás Romero Pereira until assuming the presidency on 15 August 1954. ATLAS separates this coup-to-presidency phase from his formal presidential tenure.

sources.title: Presidencia del General Alfredo Stroessner — Portal Guaraní
sources.citation_text: The Paraguayan historical portal records Stroessner's presidency from 15 August 1954 to 3 February 1989 and describes his rise through the 1954 coup.

sources.title: Alfredo Stroessner
sources.citation_text: The political chronology distinguishes Stroessner's de facto leadership from 4 May to 15 August 1954 from his subsequent presidency.
